name: SkyPulse Arcade
subtitle: Neon Flight & Cipher Puzzles
promotionalText: Explore Mcaulee Maddison’s SkyPulse: twelve Endless Route worlds, four fresh Pulse Relay circuits each UTC day, and eight Blackout Protocol cipher sectors.
description:
SkyPulse Arcade is Mcaulee Maddison’s mechanical-bird and cipher-puzzle arcade: three free offline modes with their own scenery, controls and progress.

ENDLESS ROUTE
Tap to flap, thread the gates and collect crystals as you chase your best. Travel from Neon City through Aurora Rise and Solar Drift to Cobalt Storm, Amber Skies and Polar Glow. Twelve environments change every 15 gates before the route repeats.

PULSE RELAY
Fly four fresh daily circuits through an orbital station. Collect faceted, numbered crystals to open their matching gates automatically. Follow the illuminated approach, fly through hollow 3D hoops and reach the green exit to earn a medal. Spare crystals improve your medal. Each UTC day brings new named routes. Today’s routes and medals remain stable across app restarts. Use a single tap-to-flap control, then choose Next Mission after a clear.

BLACKOUT PROTOCOL
Plan a route through eight increasingly demanding lattice puzzles. Tap connected neighbours, recover every core and reach the uplink before trace runs out. Ice and violet keys open matching locks; phase switches change mint and amber routes. Firewalls auto-breach for one charge and three trace, then a second tap enters. Blocked moves and failed breaches cost trace and can lose the sector. Each clear saves and activates the next sector immediately.

DAILY MISSION CONTROL
Complete four tasks across your attempts and claim five crystals for each, up to 20 daily-task crystals per UTC day. The daily reset time appears in your local time zone.

BUILD YOUR COLLECTION
Earn crystals to unlock 15 cosmetic birds with equal flight handling. Nine Tech Tree nodes, each with three levels, improve the Endless Route collection and reward effects shown in the game. Mission medals and Endless best are saved separately.

THREE MODES, THREE HOMES
Home starts on Endless Route. Tap the top-left badge to select a free mode. Each Home has its own scenery, animation, progress and relevant controls: flight collection, Relay circuits and cosmetic Hangar, or Blackout sector map and field guide.

Return to the selected mode’s Home with Main Menu after each run. Portrait play on iPhone and iPad, with Reduced Motion and haptic controls. Play offline with no advertising, account or real-money purchases. Progress and preferences are saved on your device.
